title: Add built-in structured request logging middleware
description: Provides developers with a zero‑dependency, configurable logger that captures method, URL, status, response time and optional request ID. This improves observability, aids debugging in production, and aligns with the framework's lightweight philosophy.
testCases: Verify that a request passing through the logger middleware outputs a correctly formatted log line containing method, URL, status code, and response time
Verify that custom log format options (e.g., JSON output, inclusion of request ID) are respected and that disabling the logger results in no output
acceptance: When the logger middleware is registered, each incoming request generates a log entry matching the default format; custom options alter the output accordingly; disabling the middleware produces no logs. No request payloads or responses are altered, and response times remain within 5 ms overhead on average.
reason: Observability is critical for production services. A built‑in, zero‑dependency logger eliminates the need for external packages, reduces bundle size, and provides a consistent, configurable way to monitor traffic and troubleshoot issues across all yantraverse applications.
